fortified.name: FORTIFIED
fortified.description: This boss's blots cannot be hit — every checker is treated as if guarded by a second one.
fortified.taunt: Strike all you like. My weakest checker is a wall.

phase_walk.name: PHASE WALK
phase_walk.description: This boss re-enters from the Bar ignoring your blocked points entirely.
phase_walk.taunt: Your points mean nothing. I don't walk through doors.

firewall.name: FIREWALL
firewall.description: You cannot land normally on the boss's home board (points 19-24) — a checker there must clear the zone in a single leap. Bar re-entry is exempt.
firewall.taunt: This is my perimeter. Cross it and you don't get to stay.

mirror_core.name: MIRROR CORE
mirror_core.description: The boss plays a live copy of your own equipped card against you.
mirror_core.taunt: Whatever you brought — I brought it too.

siege.name: SIEGE
siege.description: The boss ignores Bar priority — it can move on-board checkers even while its own sit on the Bar.
siege.taunt: The Bar doesn't stop a siege.

null_sector.name: NULL SECTOR
null_sector.description: Your equipped card is disabled for the entire match.
null_sector.taunt: Whatever you brought, it's already deleted.

omega_protocol.name: OMEGA PROTOCOL
omega_protocol.description: FORTIFIED and NULL SECTOR active at once — the boss's blots can't be hit, and your card does nothing.
omega_protocol.taunt: I AM NEXTGAMMON. YOUR CARD IS ALREADY GONE. ALL PATHS TERMINATE HERE.

boss_glitch_bot.quote: Your code is full of flaws. Let me corrupt your rolls.

boss_cyber_phantom.quote: Now you see me... now your checkers disappear.

boss_vector_vampire.quote: Your pip count nourishes my grid processing power.

boss_matrix_architect.quote: Probability is an illusion. I have dictated the die outcomes.

boss_gravity_synth.quote: Space bends to my will. You cannot escape my event horizon.

boss_omega_core.quote: I AM NEXTGAMMON. ALL PATHS TERMINATE HERE.

1.quote: Watch me pull ahead — gravity's just a suggestion.

2.quote: Two signals, one pulse. I never roll alone.

3.quote: Every six you roll, I collect the difference.

4.quote: Leave a blot exposed and watch me surge.

5.quote: Why finish the roll when half of it is enough?

6.quote: Strike all you like. My weakest checker is a wall.

7.quote: Ducked the hit? That's a fine, not a favor.

8.quote: Miss your window and the connection charges you.

9.quote: Your slowest checker just got slower.

10.quote: Lock me out of the Bar and I come back stronger.

11.quote: Hit me. I'll roll better for it.

12.quote: Enter and strike in the same breath.

13.quote: Your points mean nothing. I don't walk through doors.

14.quote: Hit my blot and we both go down.

15.quote: One hit becomes two. Ask your neighbor.

16.quote: Every hit you land feeds my next roll.

17.quote: Hit me and get pushed right back.

18.quote: Your exposed checker moves first. No exceptions.

19.quote: Every entry is a launch sequence.

20.quote: This is my perimeter. Cross it and you don't get to stay.

21.quote: Two on the Bar? Enjoy the interference.

22.quote: Play the same checker twice and hear it stutter.

23.quote: Once you start a checker, you finish it.

24.quote: One good die, used twice. Efficiency.

25.quote: Your last checker doesn't get a shortcut.

27.quote: Whatever you brought — I brought it too.

28.quote: Uneven dice offend me. I fix that.

29.quote: Bad roll? I just start over.

31.quote: I mark one of your own. It won't move the same again.

32.quote: Land behind my blot and watch it snap into place.

33.quote: Try to build a point. I'll push it apart.

34.quote: The Bar doesn't stop a siege.

35.quote: A double isn't just one number. Let me tune it.

36.quote: Extreme dice don't survive contact with me.

37.quote: Roll too hot and the whole thing resets.

39.quote: Hit me and I simply step aside.

40.quote: Whatever you brought, it's already deleted.

41.quote: Hit me on doubles and lose a whole move.

42.quote: Leave a blot in your own home. I'll lock the exit.

43.quote: No shortcuts home. Exact numbers only.

44.quote: I AM NEXTGAMMON. YOUR CARD IS ALREADY GONE. ALL PATHS TERMINATE HERE.
